findings.claim: The sim barrel re-exports nine names that nothing imports through it: `nextRange`, `nextInt`, `type Rng`, `encodeInputs`, `decodeInputs`, `replayInputs`, `type Replay`, `type WorldOptions` and `CAR_LENGTH`. As with the render barrel (C006/C024), this makes the public seam look wider than it is.
findings.evidence: src/sim/index.ts:3 `export type { World, WorldOptions }`, :8 `CAR_LENGTH`, :10 `export type { Replay }`, :13-18 `decodeInputs, ... encodeInputs, ... replayInputs`, :20-21 `export type { Rng }` / `nextRange, nextInt`. I grepped every importer of sim/index.ts: src/game.ts:10-23, src/render/car.ts:11, src/render/dust.ts:11, src/content/tracks.ts:4, src/ui/stages/*.ts, src/driver/index.ts:6, tests/**, harness/screens/{scene,capture,shots}.ts, harness/tests/*.ts, guardrails/gates/{g2-measure,g3-measure,record-replays}.ts and spikes/m2-game/inputs.ts. Between them they import only DT, CAR_WIDTH, SURFACES, COUNTDOWN_TICKS, TICK_HZ, carViews, raceView, createBot, createWorld, stepWorld, validateTrack, trackLayout, createRng, nextFloat, createReplay, encodeReplay, decodeReplay, runReplay and the types Bot, World, CarInput, CarView, RaceView, RacerView and TrackData. Tests that use CAR_LENGTH, nextInt, nextRange, encodeInputs or decodeInputs import them from car.ts, rng.ts or replay.ts directly (e.g. tests/sim/rng-vec.test.ts:2, tests/sim/replay.test.ts:4-10).
findings.suggestedFix: Remove those nine names from the re-export lists in src/sim/index.ts and leave the modules' own exports alone. Keep every name that gates, harness or tests import (the list above). This is export-list only, with no runtime change.

findings.claim: The grid comment says slots from GRID_CURVED_FROM on are reached only by six-car races. But GRID_CURVED_FROM is 4, so slot index 4 is used by any race with five or more cars, and startRace accepts 1 to 6 cars.
findings.evidence: src/sim/world.ts:46-48 `/** Slots from this index on (only six-car races reach them) follow the centreline back, ... */ const GRID_CURVED_FROM = 4;` and :72-78 `for (let i = 0; i < options.carCount; i++) { ... if (i < GRID_CURVED_FROM) {` — with carCount = 5, i = 4 takes the curved branch. createWorld (:61) accepts any positive integer carCount.
findings.suggestedFix: Change the comment to `(races of five or more cars reach them)`. Only the comment changes.

confirmations.note: The redundant second copy is gone: src/sim/track.ts:240 now returns `propRows,` directly, the same as ramps and props. Only the harmless `as const` at :224 is left, so there is nothing left to save an allocation on.

All five hand-written positive-modulo wraps are still there: track.ts:286 `points[((i % n) + n) % n]`, :429 `((s % t.length) + t.length) % t.length`, :461 `((segment % track.count) + track.count) % track.count`, :497 `((hintSeg % n) + n) % n`, :504 `(((centre + o) % n) + n) % n`. vec.ts still has no wrap helper.
